products.name: Google Workspace Migrate — Deployment & Large-Scale Migration Execution — Commercial
products.short_description: Deploy and execute with Google Workspace Migrate — node platform, M365 + Google connections, mappings/bridges, throttled migration waves, and validation — so large-scale file and mail migrations run reliably. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Run large-scale M365→Google migrations with Google Workspace Migrate

For enterprise-scale file and mailbox moves, Google Workspace Migrate is Google's native large-scale tool — but it needs node infrastructure, connections, and mappings designed correctly. This solution is the deployment + execution playbook: stand up the Migrate platform (nodes/database), connect Microsoft 365 and Google, build mappings and bridges, run scoped migration waves with throttling, and validate results — so SharePoint/OneDrive and mail move at scale, reliably.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (Admin SDK / APIs).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Google Workspace Migrate architecture (nodes, database, connections, mappings/bridges), where it fits vs other tools, and the wave model.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (node infrastructure sizing, M365 + Google admin access/scopes, network, pilot scope).
  • Implementation Guide — deploy the platform, configure connections + mappings, run a pilot wave with throttling, validate, then scale waves — pilot-first; tool-console internals deferred to Google's Migrate docs, procedure and sequencing given.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (pilot migrated + validated, throttling stable, error rate within threshold) plus Best Practices for large-scale wave execution.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Enterprise-scale migrations executed on Google's native tool — Migrate platform deployed, connections and mappings built, waves throttled and validated — reliable at scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • connection-mapping-generator.py — build & validate the mapping CSVs and identity bridge for Google Workspace Migrate
    • migration-health-check.py — check connection health and watch a running wave for throughput/throttling
    • node-sizing-assessment.py — inventory the Microsoft 365 source and recommend Google Workspace Migrate node count
    • post-migration-validation.py — validate a migrated wave against the source baseline (counts, permissions, mail)
    • wave-batch-builder.py — group in-scope users/sites into migration waves and compute a throttling plan

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
